story.text: 저만치 앞서 걷던 나는 등 뒤에서 다급하게 부르는 목소리에 걸음을 멈췄다.
story.reading: jeo-man-chi ap-seo geot-deon na-neun deung dwi-e-seo da-geup-ha-ge bu-reu-neun mok-so-ri-e geol-eum-eul meom-chwot-da.
story.en: I was walking on ahead when an urgent voice calling from behind made me stop.

story.text: 숨을 살짝 몰아쉬며 다가온 그가 손바닥 위 열쇠고리를 내밀었다. '소지품 하나가 저기 바닥에 떨어져 있던데, 혹시 아가씨 거 아니에요?'
story.reading: sum-eul sal-jjak mol-a-swi-myeo da-ga-on geu-ga son-ba-dak wi yeol-soe-go-ri-reul nae-mil-eot-da. so-ji-pum ha-na-ga jeo-gi ba-dak-e tteol-eo-jyeo it-deon-de, hok-si a-ga-ssi geo a-ni-e-yo?
story.en: Slightly out of breath from hurrying over, he held out the keychain on his palm. "I found a belonging lying on the floor over there — this wouldn't happen to be yours, would it, agassi?"

story.text: 자세히 보니 정말 내 열쇠고리였다. 잃어버린 줄도 몰랐는데. 그리고 그제야 그의 제복이 눈에 들어왔다 — 항공사 기장이었다.
story.reading: ja-se-hi bo-ni jeong-mal nae yeol-soe-go-ri-eot-da. ilh-eo-beo-rin jul-do mol-lat-neun-de. geu-ri-go geu-je-ya geu-ui je-bok-i nun-e deul-eo-wat-da — hang-gong-sa gi-jang-i-eot-da.
story.en: Looking closely, it really was my keychain. I hadn't even realized I'd lost it. Only then did I notice his uniform — he was an airline captain.

story.text: '잃어버린 것도 모르고 그냥 걸어가시던데요. 하마터면 영영 못 찾을 뻔했어요.'
story.reading: ilh-eo-beo-rin geot-do mo-reu-go geu-nyang geol-eo-ga-si-deon-de-yo. ha-ma-teo-myeon yeong-yeong mot chaj-eul ppeon-haet-seo-yo.
story.en: "You were just walking off without even realizing you'd lost it. You almost never got it back."

story.text: 그는 씩 웃으며 열쇠고리를 내 손에 살며시 쥐여 주었다. '자, 돌려드릴게요. 대신 제 소개는 하고 가야겠죠? 규현입니다. 오늘은 그냥… 지나가던 기장이고요.'
story.reading: geu-neun ssik us-eu-myeo yeol-soe-go-ri-reul nae son-e sal-myeo-si jwi-yeo ju-eot-da. ja, dol-lyeo-deu-ril-ge-yo. dae-sin je so-gae-neun ha-go ga-ya-get-jyo? gyu-hyeon-im-ni-da. o-neul-eun geu-nyang… ji-na-ga-deon gi-jang-i-go-yo.
story.en: He grinned and gently placed the keychain in my hand. "Here, let me give this back to you. Though I should probably introduce myself first, shouldn't I? I'm Kyuhyun. Today, though... I'm just a captain passing through."

story.reading: geu-rae-seo, cheon-in-sang-i eo-ttae-yo? gi-jang-chi-go na-ppeu-ji an-a-jyo?
story.en: "So, what's your first impression? Not bad, for a captain?"

story.text: 장난스럽게 웃는 그의 얼굴에서, 나는 이상하게 눈을 떼기가 어려웠다. 저 사람, 어디서 다시 만날 일이 있을까 — 그런 생각이 스쳤다.
story.reading: jang-nan-seu-reop-ge ut-neun geu-ui eol-gul-e-seo, na-neun i-sang-ha-ge nun-eul tte-gi-ga eo-ryeo-wot-da. jeo sa-ram, eo-di-seo da-si man-nal il-i iss-eul-kka — geu-reon saeng-gak-i seu-chyeot-da.
story.en: Watching his playful grin, I found it strangely hard to look away. A thought flickered through my mind — would I ever run into him again?

words.example_en: I was flustered because I'd lost my wallet.
He gave the keychain back to me.
Please keep track of your belongings.
My first impression of him wasn't bad.
